:::info

La documentación de esta integración la escribe su autor y, por ahora, solo está disponible en inglés.

:::

> **Requires Gladys 4.86 or later.**

Get the messages of Gladys on your phone, tablet or computer with
[Pushover](https://pushover.net): the notifications of your scenes, the images
of your cameras, and every message Gladys sends you.

Pushover becomes a messaging channel of Gladys, like Telegram: each Gladys user
links their own Pushover account to it, and only receives the messages meant
for them. The channel is send-only: you cannot reply to Gladys from Pushover.

## Requirements

- A [Pushover](https://pushover.net) account for each person who should receive
  the messages.
- The Pushover app installed and logged in on each device that should receive
  them ([Android, iPhone, iPad, desktop](https://pushover.net/clients)). After
  a 30-day free trial, the app is a one-time purchase per platform.
- Sending is free up to 10,000 messages a month, for the whole Pushover account
  that owns the application created below.

## Configuration (administrator)

1. Log in to [pushover.net](https://pushover.net), then open
   [Create an Application/API Token](https://pushover.net/apps/build).
2. Give it a name, **Gladys** for instance: it is the title of the
   notifications. You can also give it an icon, shown with each notification.
   Accept the terms, then click **Create Application**.
3. Copy the token shown under **API Token/Key**: 30 letters and digits.
4. In Gladys, open the configuration screen of the Pushover integration, paste
   the token into **Application API token**, then save.

The connection status then shows, for instance, `Connected to Pushover: 9996 of
10000 messages left this month.`; otherwise it shows one of the messages
described in "Troubleshooting" below.

## Receiving the messages (each user)

Each Gladys user, administrator or not, enters their own Pushover account in
the **My account** block of the integration configuration screen:

| Field                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **User key**                            | The key shown under **Your User Key**, at the top of [pushover.net](https://pushover.net) once logged in: 30 letters and digits. A [Pushover group](https://pushover.net/groups) key works too: every member of the group then gets the messages. |
| **Devices, comma-separated (optional)** | The names of your Pushover devices that should get the messages, for instance `iphone,ipad`. Their names are listed on [pushover.net](https://pushover.net). Leave empty to get the messages on all your devices.                                 |

Click **Save**. To stop receiving anything, click **Delete my values**.

A user who did not enter a key gets nothing on Pushover, which is expected: they
still get the messages in the Gladys conversation.

## Sending messages

In a scene, use the **Send Message** action, or **Send a camera image** to
attach a camera capture to the notification. Pick the recipient user, then, in
**Send through**, **All configured services** or **Pushover** alone.

The other messages Gladys sends to a user also go through Pushover as soon as
they entered their key.

What reaches your phone:

- the text of the message, up to 1,024 characters. A longer text is shortened
  and ends with "…";
- the camera image, attached to the notification. An image sent without text
  comes with the text "📷";
- the name and icon of the Pushover application created by the administrator,
  as the title of the notification.

The sound and the quiet hours are set in the Pushover app itself.

## Troubleshooting

The connection status of the configuration screen reports the problems that
affect every user. A message that could not be delivered is noted in the logs
of the integration (`Message not delivered: …`), with the reason.

**"Enter the Pushover application token in the integration settings."** Fill in
**Application API token** (see "Configuration").

**"The application token does not look right: it is 30 letters and digits,
shown on your application page on pushover.net."** The token entered does not
have the shape of a Pushover token. Copy it again from your application page,
without spaces: make sure you did not paste your user key instead.

**"Pushover refused the application token. Check it in the integration
settings."** The token has the right shape, but Pushover does not know it: the
application was deleted, or the token belongs to another application. No
message is sent until you save a valid token.

**"The monthly Pushover message limit is reached. It resets on the 1st of the
month."** The Pushover account owning the application sent its 10,000 messages
of the month, all applications included. Reduce the number of messages your
scenes send, or buy more capacity from Pushover. Gladys stops asking Pushover
until the quota resets.

**"Pushover cannot be reached. Check the Internet access of the Gladys
machine."**, **"Pushover did not answer in time. Try again later."**,
**"Pushover is having trouble (HTTP …). Try again later."** Gladys could not
reach Pushover: Internet outage, or a Pushover incident (see its
[status page](https://status.pushover.net/)). Messages sent meanwhile are lost.
The status turns back to "connected" with the first message sent successfully.

**"Unexpected answer instead of Pushover: check the Internet access of the
Gladys machine (proxy, captive portal)."** Another page answered instead of
Pushover: a captive portal or a proxy filters the Internet access.

In the logs of the integration, for one message:

- **`The Pushover user key in "My account" does not look right`**: the user key
  entered in **My account** does not have the shape of a Pushover key. Enter it
  again.
- **`Pushover refused the user key, or the account has no active device`**: the
  key does not exist, or no device is active on that Pushover account. Open the
  Pushover app on your phone to activate it. The same key is not tried again for
  10 minutes; a corrected key is used right away.
- **`Invalid Pushover device name(s) in "My account"`**: a device name contains
  a forbidden character. A device name is at most 25 characters: letters,
  digits, `-` and `_`.
- **`Pushover refused the message (…)`**: Pushover refused the message, for the
  reason given in parentheses.

**I get nothing, and the logs show no error.** Check that your key is saved in
**My account**, that the scene sends the message to your user and through
Pushover or all services, and that the Pushover app is logged in on your
phone. During your Pushover quiet hours, messages arrive silently.

## Privacy

- The application token and the user keys are stored by Gladys as secrets: they
  are never shown again in the interface.
- The text of the messages and the camera images go through the Pushover
  servers, which delete them once delivered to your devices. See the
  [Pushover privacy policy](https://pushover.net/privacy).
- The integration only talks to Gladys and to the Pushover API
  (`api.pushover.net`).

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que Pushover te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Create a Pushover application | `section` | No | Gladys sends its messages through an application registered on your Pushover account. Create one (free, name it Gladys for instance), then paste its API token below. Each Gladys user then enters their own Pushover user key in the "My account" block. |
| Application API token | `secret` | Sí |  |

## Cómo instalar Pushover en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: Pushover aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/cicoub13/gladys-pushover:0.1.2`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/cicoub13/gladys-pushover](https://github.com/cicoub13/gladys-pushover).

Pushover requiere Gladys `>=4.86.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

Pushover es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [cicoub13](https://github.com/cicoub13), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
